description: This is a C source file for a Bluetooth Mesh provisioner sample application using Zephyr RTOS. It handles provisioning, configuration, and health monitoring of mesh nodes, including button interaction and mesh network setup.

methods.name: health_current_status
methods.description: Handles the current health status report from a mesh node, printing faults if any.

methods.name: setup_cdb
methods.description: Sets up the Configuration Database with an application key.

methods.name: configure_self
methods.description: Configures the local node with application key and binds health client model.

methods.name: configure_node
methods.description: Configures a remote node by adding application key, retrieving composition data, and binding models.

methods.name: unprovisioned_beacon
methods.description: Callback for unprovisioned beacon detection, stores UUID and signals semaphore.

methods.name: node_added
methods.description: Callback when a node is added, stores address and signals semaphore.

methods.name: bt_ready
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth mesh, loads settings, creates or loads CDB, and provisions the device.

methods.name: check_unconfigured
methods.description: Iterates over nodes to configure unconfigured nodes or self.

methods.name: button_pressed
methods.description: Interrupt callback for button press, signals semaphore.

methods.name: button_init
methods.description: Initializes GPIO button for provisioning trigger.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop that initializes Bluetooth, handles provisioning, and waits for nodes.
